It reports approximately 99.6% of votes cast in favor, representing approximately 81.0% of outstanding shares entitled to vote. It says closing is expected by mid-2027, subject to remaining required regulatory approvals and customary conditions. (time=2026-09-24T20:30:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
